notes: Full description: pkix-lint/tests/cabf_tls_br_tests.rs ValidityMaxLint tests (lines 82-151) only test two of the four SC-081 phases: the pre-2026-03-15 phase (398-day cap) and the post-2026-03-15 phase (200-day cap). There are no integration tests for the 2027-03-15 (100-day cap) and 2029-03-15 (47-day cap) phase boundaries. The sc081_validity_cap() function in pkix-profiles is tested for all four boundaries (pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs lines 519-568), but the full integration through ValidityMaxLint::check_cert() is only exercised for the first two phases. Fix: Add test fixtures or synthetic certs representing the 100-day and 47-day cap phases, and add tests: validity_max_error_post_sc081_100d(), validity_max_pass_100d_cert_at_100d_phase(), validity_max_error_post_sc081_47d(), validity_max_pass_47d_cert_at_47d_phase(). Priority: P3 (test coverage gap for future phase boundaries).
title: FINDING: tests for cabf_tls_br scope sc081 transitions at 2027 and 2029 missing
